master.definition_en: An aspergillosis that is a serious fungal infection of the lung with pneumonia caused by Aspergillus, which spreads to other parts of the body through bloodstream in patients with acute leukemia and recipients of tissue transplants. Clinical symptoms include pulmonary nodules and hemorrhage.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 曲霉菌孢子侵入肺部血管甚至播散至脑部，常袭扰白血病化疗粒缺、移植、ICU重症病毒性肺炎（流感/新冠后）及重度COPD患者；若未及时启动强效抗真菌治疗，数日至数周内因大咯血、呼吸衰竭或脑曲霉病致命，全球粗病死率极高。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早期凭胸部CT（晕征/空气新月征）、GM试验及BALF mNGS确诊并立即予伏立康唑或艾沙康唑治疗，部分患者可治愈；但粒细胞缺乏未恢复、脑播散或唑类耐药株感染病死率仍极高。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Denning（Lancet Infectious Diseases 2024）重估全球每年约211.3万例侵袭性曲霉病，粗病死率约85.2%（年死亡约180.1万例，主要伴发于COPD住院、ICU、肺癌及血液肿瘤人群）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国未单列侵袭性曲霉病官方死因统计；国内COPD基数庞大且血液移植及ICU救治规模增长，重症流感/新冠相关肺曲霉病（IAPA/CAPA）院内负担沉重。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球年发病约2,113,000例（另慢性肺曲霉病年新发约183.7万例）。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国高危血液肿瘤、异基因造血干细胞移植及ICU重症呼吸衰竭患者中侵袭性肺曲霉病检出率位居深部真菌感染前列。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：白血病化疗后粒缺、器官移植、长期大剂量激素或重度慢阻肺患者，若高热对广谱抗生素无效超过3–5天，突发胸痛、痰中带血或大咯血、呼吸急促或突发剧烈头痛意识障碍（警惕脑播散），立即急诊住院！严禁继续单纯升级普通抗菌药（对真菌完全无效！）或自行使用普通止咳药掩盖大咯血；急诊立即查高分辨肺CT、血清/肺泡灌洗液GM试验及支气管镜，并抢先启动一线抗曲霉药物；突发大咯血时患侧卧位防窒息并急诊行支气管动脉栓塞。

standard_drugs.drug_class: 三唑类抗真菌药（抑制麦角固醇合成，破坏真菌细胞膜）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 侵袭性曲霉病全球公认一线首选治疗（需行血药谷浓度TDM监测）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 口服片剂集采约15–40元/片；注射用伏立康唑约80–200元/支（集采后大幅降价）
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家药品集中带量采购及公立医院参考价

standard_drugs.drug_class: 新型广谱三唑类抗真菌药（覆盖曲霉及毛霉，肝毒性与QT间期延长风险更低）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 与伏立康唑并列的一线选择，尤适于不能耐受伏立康唑肝/视神经毒性或肾功能不全者
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国家常规目录谈判后费用显著下降，完整疗程约10,000–25,000元
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家常规临床用药目录谈判参考价

standard_drugs.drug_class: 多烯类广谱杀菌抗真菌药
standard_drugs.usage_role: 唑类耐药曲霉或高度怀疑合并毛霉菌感染时的强效替代/挽救治疗
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国产脂质体/进口制剂单支约数百至千余元，疗程费用较高
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家常规临床用药目录参考价

non_drug_therapies_zh: 高危粒缺及移植患者入住层流病房（HEPA过滤空气），远离装修扬尘、发霉谷物土壤及盆栽植物
治疗期间定期监测伏立康唑血药浓度（TDM）、肝功能及电解质，避免与利福平、卡马西平等强肝酶诱导剂合用
孤立性肺曲霉球靠近大血管有致命大咯血风险或药物控制不佳时，评估介入支气管动脉栓塞或胸外科病灶切除
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 标准6–12周抗曲霉治疗（含CT、GM监测及TDM）药物与住院总费用约20,000–80,000元；ICU重症或耐药株联合用药费用更高。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 全新机制抗真菌新药进入III期临床或获批突破：包括首个Olorofim（二氢乳清酸脱氢酶抑制剂，对唑类耐药曲霉及难治性霉菌有效）及Fosmanogepix（Gwt1抑制剂）；吸入用高浓度局部抗曲霉制剂（如PC945）在肺移植及气道曲霉病中展现减少全身毒性的优势。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 全球耐唑类烟曲霉（TR34/L98H突变）比例上升，一线伏立康唑耐药后挽救方案有限且毒性大; 2) 早期非培养诊断（GM/PCR）在基层医院可及性不足，常错过黄金治疗窗; 3) 重度免疫抑制患者即便足量用药，粗病死率仍高达50%–85%。

master.definition_en: Beukes familial hip dysplasia (BFHD) is a primary bone dysplasia, characterized by premature degenerative arthropathy of the hip. The disease presents with hip joint discomfort/pain and gait disturbances that usually develops in childhood and that progresses to severe functional disability and limited mobility by early adulthood. Involvement of the vertebral bodies and other joints is minimal, height is not significantly reduced, and general health is unimpaired. Radiographically, the femoral heads are flattened and irregular and degenerative osteoarthritis develops in the hip joints, as evidenced by the presence of periarticular cysts, sclerosis, and joint space narrowing.

The oculomotor manifestations tend to improve with age but the syndrome may also be associated with learning and speech difficulties, or, in some cases, cerebral malformations. master.definition_en: Toluene embryopathy is a neurodevelopmental teratologic syndrome due to prenatal exposure to toluene. The disease is characterized by prematurity, low birth weight, dysmorphic features (short palpebral fissures, deep set eyes, low set ears, mid-facial hypoplasia, flat nasal bridge, thin upper lip, micrognathia, spatulate fingertips and small fingernails), central nervous system dysfunctions (intellectual disability, microcephaly, language impairment, hyperactivity, visual dysfunction) and postnatal growth delay. Prenatal exposure to toluene occurs as a result of incidental occupational exposure or solvent abuse during pregnancy. The features of toluene embryopathy often overlap with those seen in fetal alcohol syndrome.
synonyms_en: microcephaly, central nervous system dysfunction, minor craniofacial and limb anomalies, and variable growth deficiency

master.definition_en: A rare autoimmune disease with skin involvement characterized by recurrent episodes with isolated or multiple painful edematous inflammatory skin lesions progressing to ecchymoses within 24 hours, due to autosensitization to a stromal component of the patient's own erythrocytes. The development of the lesions is usually preceded by emotional or physical stress, followed by a prodromal stage with fatigue or malaise. Lower limbs and trunk are the most frequently involved sites. Accompanying features may include fever, arthralgia, myalgia, headache, gastrointestinal problems, or hematuria and epistaxis, among others. The disease occurs predominantly in women.

master.definition_en: The most malignant astrocytic tumor (WHO grade IV). It is composed of poorly differentiated neoplastic astrocytes and it is characterized by the presence of cellular polymorphism, nuclear atypia, brisk mitotic activity, vascular thrombosis, microvascular proliferation and necrosis. It typically affects adults and is preferentially located in the cerebral hemispheres. It may develop from diffuse astrocytoma WHO grade II or anaplastic astrocytoma (secondary glioblastoma, IDH-mutant), but more frequently, it manifests after a short clinical history de novo, without evidence of a less malignant precursor lesion (primary glioblastoma, IDH- wildtype). (Adapted from WHO)

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: Single-organ polyarteritis nodosa (PAN) is a rare, often mild form of PAN characterized by limited disease without generalized manifestations, most often affecting the skin (cutaneous PAN), the brain, eyes, pancreas, testicles, ureter, breasts, or ovaries. Affected patients are often younger than those with systemic PAN and relapses appear to be more common.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.name_en: autosomal dominant myopia-midfacial retrusion-sensorineural hearing loss-rhizomelic dysplasia syndrome
master.definition_en: A rare primary bone dysplasia characterized by micromelia with rhizomelic shortening, metaphyseal widening of the long bones, brachydactyly, small scapulae, micrognathia and thoracic insufficiency requiring tracheostomy and ventilation, and severe myopia and sensorineural hearing loss. Further dysmorphic craniofacial features include frontal bossing, proptosis, epicanthal folds, short nose, flat nasal bridge, anteverted nares, midfacial retrusion, and cleft palate.
synonyms_en: Autosomal dominant myopia-midfacial retrusion-sensorineural deafness-rhizomelic dysplasia syndrome
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: A rare genetic cerebral small vessel disease characterized by subcortical ischemic events associated with cognitive decline and gait disturbance with an age of onset typically in the sixth or seventh decade of life. Imaging reveals white matter hyperintensities, status cribrosum, lacunar infarcts, and sometimes microbleeds. Extra-neurological manifestations are absent.

master.definition_en: Secondary intestinal lymphangiectasia is an acquired from of intestinal lymphangiectasia manifesting as a protein-losing enteropathy due to another disorder such as CrohnBs disease, congestive heart failure, sarcoidosis, Turner syndrome and often in patients who have undergone a Fontan operation. It is characterized by malabsorption, diarrhea, edema due hypoproteinemia, steatorrhea and serosal effusions.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: A rare, benign tumor of the pancreas characterized by variable number and size of the cysts lined with glycogen rich epithelial cells. Clinical manifestation may include epigastric or abdominal pain, weight loss, diabetes, jaundice and palpable abdominal mass. Some patients have no symptoms and the tumor is discovered incidentally.

master.definition_en: A form of dermatomyositis characterized by the presence of typical skin finding swithout muscle weakness. Some of the skin changes that suggest dermatomyositis include a pink rash on the face, neck, forearms and upper chest; Gottron's papules and heliotrope eyelids. Pruritis and photosensitivity are common, as is scalp inflammation and thinning of the hair.While patients with amyopathic dermatomyositis should not have clinically evident muscle weakness, minor muscle abnormalities may be included.Fatigue is reported in at least 50% of patients. Some cases have beenassociated with internal malignancy and/or interstitial lung disease. Treatment may include sun avoidance, ample use of sunscreen, topical corticosteroids, antimalarial agents, methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil, or intravenous (IV) immunoglobulin.

master.definition_en: A broad classification of dysgammaglobulinemias characterized by low or undetectable serum levels of immunoglobulin class G (IgG). Deficiencies of IgG present variably according to subclass. IgG deficiencies are typically relative among subclasses and not absolute. Thus even with a given selective IgG subclass deficiency, total IgG levels may still fall within normal range. The clinical course and prognosis is dependent upon the severity of the deficiency and associated morbidity.

Association with other congenital defects or systemic diseases is uncommon.

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: FIBROSIS of the hepatic parenchyma due to obstruction of BILE flow ( CHOLESTASIS) in the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts ( BILE DUCTS, INTRAHEPATIC; BILE DUCTS, EXTRAHEPATIC). Primary biliary cirrhosis involves the destruction of small intra-hepatic bile ducts and bile secretion. Secondary biliary cirrhosis is produced by prolonged obstruction of large intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts from a variety of causes.
